question: How do people behave when established in awareness beyond conceptualization?
premises: One who attains happiness forgets earlier suffering through resting in happiness.
Likewise, people established in awareness beyond conceptualization do not dwell on conceptual thought.
inference: Absorption in non-conceptual awareness naturally displaces conceptual activity, just as present happiness displaces past suffering.
plain_english: Just as someone who has found happiness forgets earlier suffering by resting in that happiness, so people who are firmly established in awareness, even when conceptual thought has gone, no longer cling to it.
